name: masp-profiles
description: [MASP](https://github.com/Language-Research-Technology/ro-crate-masp) (Machine Actionable Schema/Profile) crates used by [resources2crate](https://github.com/benfoley/resources2crate) to drive its folder → RO-Crate build workflow: the profile you pick determines which fields the Describe step asks for and which Build options are shown, and the finished crate is checked against it with `MaspValidator.validateCrate()`.
